With high total catalyst, both [catS] and free [cat] will be highly populated, leading to an explosive initial rate of product formation that far exceeds the linear scaling expected from simple mechanisms.
- For M11 (S + cat => inactive), the high catalyst concentration means a larger pool of free `cat` will be available to react with the moderate substrate, leading to steady deactivation but lacking the extreme quadratic crash of M18 or the explosive initial rate of M5.
